milestones.headline_zh: 三星生物制剂 Plant 4 全面商业化运营，松岛产能登顶全球 CDMO 第一
milestones.headline_en: Samsung Biologics Plant 4 fully operational; Songdo becomes the world's largest single-site biologics CDMO campus
milestones.before_gap_zh: 此前全球最大单站点生物药 CDMO 产能由欧美（Lonza Visp、Lonza Portsmouth）保持。
milestones.before_gap_en: Prior to Plant 4, the largest single-site biologics CDMO capacity sat with European and US incumbents (Lonza Visp, Lonza Portsmouth).
milestones.achievement_zh: 2023 年 9 月 Plant 4 投产，三星生物松岛合计 604,800 L 产能，超过任何欧美同类单站点。
milestones.achievement_en: Plant 4 GMP operations began in 2023, bringing total Songdo capacity to 604,800 L — exceeding any comparable Western single site.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 在 mRNA、ADC 与连续化生物工艺上仍落后于欧美同行。
milestones.still_missing_en: Still trails Western peers in mRNA, ADC payload/linker and continuous bioprocessing.

milestones.headline_zh: ICON 完成 120 亿美元并购 PRA Health，跃居全球第二临床 CRO
milestones.headline_en: ICON closes US$12B PRA Health Sciences merger, becoming world's #2 clinical CRO by revenue
milestones.before_gap_zh: 此前 ICON 在全球临床 CRO 排名约第 3-4 位，规模显著落后于 IQVIA。
milestones.before_gap_en: Pre-merger ICON ranked ~3-4 globally among clinical CROs, well behind IQVIA.
milestones.achievement_zh: 2021 年 7 月以约 120 亿美元完成并购，合并营收使 ICON 体量翻倍。
milestones.achievement_en: Closed July 2021 at ~US$12B, doubling combined revenue and lifting ICON to #2.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 数据资产与真实世界证据能力仍弱于 IQVIA。
milestones.still_missing_en: Real-world evidence and data assets still smaller than IQVIA's.

sources.title: ICON completes acquisition of PRA Health Sciences

milestones.headline_zh: 药明生物爱尔兰敦多克 MFG4 投产，成为最大中国生物药 CDMO 海外基地
milestones.headline_en: WuXi Biologics' Dundalk MFG4 site begins GMP production, becoming the largest Chinese biologics CDMO footprint outside China
milestones.before_gap_zh: 中国 CDMO 此前主要在国内生产，海外商业化产能有限。
milestones.before_gap_en: Chinese CDMOs had limited overseas commercial-scale biomanufacturing capacity.
milestones.achievement_zh: 2022 年 MFG4 (48,000 L) 在爱尔兰敦多克投产，为非中国市场客户提供本地化原液与制剂。
milestones.achievement_en: Dundalk MFG4 (48,000 L) began GMP production in 2022, providing non-China commercial-scale DS/DP to Western clients.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 全球合规与 ESG 治理体系仍落后于 Lonza 等老牌欧洲同行。
milestones.still_missing_en: Global compliance maturity and ESG governance still lag European incumbents like Lonza.

milestones.headline_zh: Novo Holdings 完成 165 亿美元私有化收购 Catalent，对接 GLP-1 注射剂产能
milestones.headline_en: Novo Holdings closes US$16.5B Catalent take-private, securing GLP-1 injectable fill-finish capacity
milestones.before_gap_zh: Novo Nordisk 受限于自有无菌灌装产能，Wegovy / Ozempic 持续供不应求。
milestones.before_gap_en: Novo Nordisk was constrained by in-house sterile fill-finish capacity, causing Wegovy/Ozempic shortages.
milestones.achievement_zh: 2024 年 12 月交易完成，Novo Nordisk 通过三方采购协议直接获得 Catalent 的 Anagni (意大利)、Bloomington (印第安纳) 等灌装线。
milestones.achievement_en: Deal closed Dec 2024; Novo Nordisk gained direct access to Catalent's Anagni (IT) and Bloomington (IN) fill-finish lines via related-party supply deals.
milestones.still_missing_zh: Catalent 原 CTLT 上市地位退市，少数股东对估值不满。
milestones.still_missing_en: Catalent delisted from NYSE; minority shareholders contested the valuation.

sources.title: Novo Holdings completes acquisition of Catalent

milestones.headline_zh: 微创CRM Platinium ICD获NMPA批准，成中国首款国产ICD
milestones.headline_en: MicroPort CRM Platinium ICD gains NMPA approval as China's first domestically developed ICD
milestones.before_gap_zh: 植入式心律转复除颤器（ICD）市场长期被美敦力、波士顿科学、雅培等外资品牌垄断，中国患者依赖进口
milestones.before_gap_en: The ICD market in China was entirely dependent on imports from Medtronic, Boston Scientific, and Abbott; no domestic alternative existed
milestones.achievement_zh: 微创CRM开发的Platinium ICD于2024年10月获NMPA上市批准，成为中国首款自主研发的ICD，打破外资垄断
milestones.achievement_en: MicroPort CRM's Platinium ICD received NMPA marketing approval in October 2024, becoming China's first domestically developed and approved ICD, breaking the foreign monopoly
milestones.still_missing_zh: 市场渗透率及与进口品牌的长期临床证据对比仍需时间积累；皮下ICD（S-ICD）等高端产品尚未国产化
milestones.still_missing_en: Market penetration and long-term clinical evidence versus import brands still needs to accumulate; subcutaneous ICD (S-ICD) and other advanced variants remain to be developed domestically

sources.title: MicroPort CRM Platinium ICD NMPA Approval Press Release

milestones.headline_zh: 华大智造DNBSEQ测序平台成为全球范围Illumina的有力竞争者
milestones.headline_en: MGI DNBSEQ sequencing platform emerges as a viable global alternative to Illumina
milestones.before_gap_zh: 全球基因测序仪市场由Illumina近乎垄断，中国缺乏自主高通量测序设备
milestones.before_gap_en: The global sequencer market was near-monopolized by Illumina; China lacked domestically developed high-throughput sequencing instruments
milestones.achievement_zh: 华大智造DNBSEQ系列仪器通过CE认证并进入欧洲市场，与Illumina形成实质竞争，海外销售持续增长
milestones.achievement_en: MGI DNBSEQ instruments obtained CE certification and entered European markets, forming substantive competition with Illumina, with overseas sales growing strongly
milestones.still_missing_zh: 短读长测序之外的长读长平台（PacBio / Oxford Nanopore）尚无国产等效产品；整体市场份额仍远低于Illumina
milestones.still_missing_en: Long-read sequencing platforms (PacBio/Oxford Nanopore) still lack domestic equivalents; overall market share still well below Illumina

milestones.headline_zh: 科伦博泰与默克签署七款临床前ADC资产独家授权协议
milestones.headline_en: Kelun-Biotech signs exclusive license with Merck for 7 preclinical ADC assets
milestones.before_gap_zh: 中国ADC企业缺乏全球顶级跨国制药公司认可及国际市场准入能力
milestones.before_gap_en: Chinese ADC developers lacked validation from top multinational pharma and global commercialization pathways
milestones.achievement_zh: 科伦博泰以175亿元人民币潜在里程碑达成与MSD的ADC平台全面战略合作，奠定中国ADC研发的全球地位
milestones.achievement_en: Kelun-Biotech secured a multi-billion USD ADC platform partnership with Merck including USD 175M upfront + up to USD 1.36B in milestones for 7 novel ADC candidates, validating China's ADC innovation globally
milestones.still_missing_zh: ADC药物在中国商业化仍处早期，国产ADC出海全面商业化有待实现
milestones.still_missing_en: Domestic ADC commercialisation in China is still early-stage; full ex-China commercialisation of Chinese-origin ADCs is yet to be achieved

sources.title: Merck and Kelun-Biotech Announce Exclusive License and Collaboration Agreement - Merck.com
Kelun's Merck-partnered ADC snags first nod in China - FiercePharma

milestones.headline_zh: 科伦博泰SKB264（芦康沙妥珠单抗）获NMPA批准用于三阴性乳腺癌
milestones.headline_en: Kelun-Biotech's SKB264 (sac-TMT) receives NMPA approval for triple-negative breast cancer
milestones.before_gap_zh: 中国TNBC患者缺乏中国本土研发的TROP2靶向ADC治疗选择
milestones.before_gap_en: Chinese TNBC patients lacked domestically developed TROP2-targeted ADC therapy options
milestones.achievement_zh: 中国首款获批的TROP2 ADC，也是首个由中国企业独立研发并获批的同类药物，与Gilead同类产品Trodelvy竞争
milestones.achievement_en: First approved TROP2-targeted ADC in China; first such drug independently developed by a Chinese company, competing with Gilead's Trodelvy
milestones.still_missing_zh: 需要更多适应症扩展（如NSCLC、HR+/HER2-乳腺癌）及全球注册数据
milestones.still_missing_en: Additional indication expansions (NSCLC, HR+/HER2- breast cancer) and ex-China registration data still needed

sources.title: Kelun's Merck-partnered ADC snags first nod in China - FiercePharma

milestones.headline_zh: 复星医药汉曲优获欧盟批准，成为首个在欧上市的中国研发生物类似药
milestones.headline_en: Fosun Pharma's Hanquyou (Zercepac) approved by EMA — first China-developed biosimilar approved in Europe
milestones.before_gap_zh: 中国制药企业从未有生物类似药进入欧洲市场
milestones.before_gap_en: No Chinese pharma had previously brought a biosimilar to the European market
milestones.achievement_zh: 汉曲优（欧洲商品名Zercepac）成为首个获欧盟批准的中国研发生物类似药，已在超过30个国家及地区获批
milestones.achievement_en: Hanquyou/Zercepac became the first Chinese-developed biosimilar approved by EMA; subsequently approved in 30+ countries including UK, France, Germany, Australia
milestones.still_missing_zh: 美国FDA上市申请仍在审核中；与欧洲本地化商业化能力尚有差距
milestones.still_missing_en: US FDA BLA still under review; full independent commercialization in Europe vs. originator remains a gap

sources.title: Fosun Pharma 2023 Annual Results - Fosun Pharma IR
Fosun Pharma 2023 Interim Results - PR Newswire

milestones.headline_zh: Brukinsa（泽布替尼）在ALPINE头对头III期试验中首次证明BTK抑制剂优于伊布替尼
milestones.headline_en: Brukinsa (zanubrutinib) demonstrates superiority over ibrutinib in head-to-head Phase 3 ALPINE trial — first BTK inhibitor to beat ibrutinib
milestones.before_gap_zh: 伊布替尼（亿珂®，AbbVie/J&J）长期主导BTK抑制剂市场，无竞争对手在随机对照III期试验中证明疗效更优
milestones.before_gap_en: Ibrutinib (Imbruvica®, AbbVie/J&J) dominated the BTK inhibitor market with no competitor demonstrating superiority in a randomized Phase 3 head-to-head trial
milestones.achievement_zh: ALPINE试验（652例R/R CLL/SLL患者）证明泽布替尼无进展生存期显著优于伊布替尼（HR=0.65，P=0.002），同时心脏不良事件更少
milestones.achievement_en: ALPINE trial (652 patients R/R CLL/SLL) showed zanubrutinib achieved significantly longer PFS vs ibrutinib (HR=0.65, P=0.002) with fewer cardiac adverse events; ORR 80.4% vs 72.9% (P=0.0264)
milestones.still_missing_zh: 尚无OS获益数据；伊布替尼在部分CLL亚型中仍广泛使用；泽布替尼在发展中市场可及性有限
milestones.still_missing_en: Overall survival benefit not yet demonstrated; ibrutinib remains widely used in some CLL subtypes; zanubrutinib access limited in developing markets

总缓解率（泽布替尼 vs 伊布替尼）

milestones.headline_zh: 依沃西单抗（AK112）在HARMONi-2 III期试验中头对头击败帕博利珠单抗（K药），成为全球首个在随机对照III期中超越K药的药物
milestones.headline_en: Ivonescimab (AK112) beats pembrolizumab (Keytruda) head-to-head in Phase 3 HARMONi-2 — first drug to demonstrate superiority over Keytruda in a randomized controlled trial
milestones.before_gap_zh: 帕博利珠单抗（K药，默沙东）是一线PD-L1阳性NSCLC标准治疗，无任何药物在随机对照III期中击败过K药单药
milestones.before_gap_en: Pembrolizumab (Keytruda, MSD/Merck) was the standard first-line monotherapy for PD-L1-positive NSCLC; no drug had ever beaten Keytruda monotherapy in a randomized Phase 3 trial
milestones.achievement_zh: HARMONi-2（398例中国一线PD-L1+晚期NSCLC患者），依沃西单抗中位PFS 11.14个月 vs 帕博利珠单抗5.82个月（HR=0.51，P<0.0001），降低疾病进展风险49%
milestones.achievement_en: HARMONi-2 (398 patients, first-line PD-L1+ advanced NSCLC in China): ivonescimab median PFS 11.14 mo vs pembrolizumab 5.82 mo (HR=0.51, P<0.0001); 49% reduction in progression/death risk
milestones.still_missing_zh: HARMONi-2仅在中国人群中进行；全球多区域III期（HARMONi）尚在进行；总生存数据待成熟；FDA/EMA批准尚未获得
milestones.still_missing_en: HARMONi-2 conducted only in Chinese patients; global multi-regional Phase 3 (HARMONi) ongoing; overall survival data immature; FDA/EMA approvals not yet obtained

milestones.headline_zh: 卡度尼利单抗获NMPA批准，成为全球首个用于治疗癌症适应症的双免疫检查点抑制剂
milestones.headline_en: Cadonilimab approved by NMPA as the world's first bispecific dual immune checkpoint inhibitor (PD-1/CTLA-4) approved for cancer
milestones.before_gap_zh: 双免疫检查点抑制剂长期停留在临床阶段，无任何PD-1/CTLA-4双抗获批上市；肿瘤免疫治疗依赖单靶点单抗（如O药+K药联用方案）
milestones.before_gap_en: Bispecific dual immune checkpoint inhibitors remained in clinical stage; no PD-1/CTLA-4 bispecific had been approved; combination IO relied on two separate monotherapy antibodies (e.g. nivolumab + ipilimumab)
milestones.achievement_zh: 卡度尼利单抗（AK104）2022年6月获NMPA批准用于宫颈癌，单分子同时阻断PD-1和CTLA-4，开创肿瘤双免疫检查点抑制剂时代
milestones.achievement_en: Cadonilimab (AK104) received NMPA approval in June 2022 for cervical cancer; single molecule simultaneously blocking PD-1 and CTLA-4; inaugurates the era of bispecific dual IO therapy
milestones.still_missing_zh: FDA/EMA全球批准尚待获得；在PD-L1高表达患者中相对K药的优效性尚未在头对头III期中证明
milestones.still_missing_en: FDA/EMA global approvals not yet achieved; superiority vs pembrolizumab in PD-L1 high expressors not yet demonstrated in head-to-head Phase 3

metrics.value: First bispecific dual IO approved for cancer globally

sources.title: Akeso Cadonilimab First Global Approval Press Release

milestones.headline_zh: 特瑞普利单抗（LOQTORZI®）获FDA批准，成为全球首个获批治疗鼻咽癌的药物，填补东亚高发癌症治疗空白
milestones.headline_en: Toripalimab (LOQTORZI®) receives FDA approval as the world's first approved therapy for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) — addressing a long-unmet need in an East Asia-prevalent cancer
milestones.before_gap_zh: 鼻咽癌无FDA批准药物；该癌症在东南亚、中国南部高发，全球每年新发约13万例，西方制药公司缺乏研发动力
milestones.before_gap_en: No FDA-approved therapy existed for NPC; this cancer predominates in Southeast Asia and South China (~130,000 new cases/year globally) but lacked Western R&D investment due to geographic mismatch
milestones.achievement_zh: 2023年10月FDA批准LOQTORZI（特瑞普利单抗）用于鼻咽癌全线治疗，基于JUPITER-02（III期）和POLARIS-02（II期），一线联合化疗使PFS风险降低48%
milestones.achievement_en: FDA approved LOQTORZI (toripalimab-tpzi) in October 2023 for all lines of NPC; based on JUPITER-02 Phase 3 (48% PFS reduction vs chemo alone) and POLARIS-02 Phase 2; first China-origin IO drug to gain FDA approval
milestones.still_missing_zh: OS数据仍在成熟中；EMA批准尚未获得；在低收入高发地区可及性受限于价格
milestones.still_missing_en: OS data still maturing; EMA approval not yet obtained; access in low-income high-prevalence regions limited by price

metrics.label_zh: JUPITER-02中位PFS改善（联合化疗 vs 化疗）

sources.title: FDA Approval of LOQTORZI for NPC

milestones.headline_zh: Carvykti（西达基奥仑赛）获FDA批准，中国CAR-T疗法首次进入全球一线市场，2024年销售额接近10亿美元
milestones.headline_en: Carvykti (ciltacabtagene autoleucel) receives FDA approval — China-originated CAR-T enters the global market and approaches $1B in sales by 2024
milestones.before_gap_zh: BCMA CAR-T（如ide-cel/百慕塔基奥仑赛）率先获批，但中国来源的CAR-T疗法无法进入美国/欧洲市场
milestones.before_gap_en: BCMA CAR-T space existed (ide-cel/idecabtagene vicleucel first approved 2021), but no China-originated CAR-T had entered the US/European markets
milestones.achievement_zh: Carvykti 2022年2月FDA获批（R/R MM），2022年EMA获批，CARTITUDE-4 III期证明早线优于标准治疗，2024年全球净贸易销售额达9.63亿美元
milestones.achievement_en: Carvykti received FDA approval February 2022 (R/R MM ≥4 prior lines), EMA approval in 2022; CARTITUDE-4 Phase 3 showed superiority in earlier lines; net trade sales $963M in FY2024
milestones.still_missing_zh: 生产能力扩张是瓶颈（个性化制造）；中国内地NMPA批准用于更多适应症；全球BCMA CAR-T竞争加剧
milestones.still_missing_en: Manufacturing capacity remains a bottleneck (personalized autologous manufacturing); broader NMPA indications in mainland China; competition from other BCMA CAR-Ts intensifying

sources.title: Carvykti second-line FDA approval press release

milestones.headline_en: Fruquintinib (Fruzaqla) approved by US FDA
milestones.before_gap_zh: 中国创新肿瘤药缺乏欧美主流市场批准
milestones.before_gap_en: China-discovered oncology drugs lacked major Western approvals
milestones.achievement_zh: 首款中国本土发现、在美国/EU/日本均获批的抗肿瘤小分子
milestones.achievement_en: First China-discovered oncology small molecule approved in US, EU and Japan

milestones.before_gap_zh: 肺癌EGFR靶向治疗依赖进口药物

milestones.before_gap_en: China lacked oral innovative drugs for lymphoma

milestones.achievement_en: Launched globally first-in-class epigenetic drug in China

milestones.still_missing_en: Global rights returned from Biogen; US/EU registration ongoing

milestones.before_gap_en: Domestic PD-L1 innovators lacked major MNC commercial networks

milestones.headline_en: Hanlikang approved — China's first biosimilar

milestones.still_missing_en: Gene therapy as potential cure still in development; high cost limits global access

milestones.headline_zh: 达格列净（Farxiga）扩展至心力衰竭和慢性肾病适应证，开创SGLT2跨适应证时代
milestones.headline_en: Dapagliflozin (Farxiga) expands into heart failure and CKD — SGLT2 class enters multi-indication era
milestones.before_gap_zh: SGLT2抑制剂仅被视为降糖药物，心衰和CKD缺乏有效保护性口服药物
milestones.before_gap_en: SGLT2 inhibitors viewed only as glucose-lowering; HF and CKD lacked effective oral cardioprotective drugs
milestones.achievement_zh: DAPA-HF和DAPA-CKD试验证实达格列净降低心衰住院率和CKD进展风险，FDA于2020-2021年批准新适应证
milestones.achievement_en: DAPA-HF and DAPA-CKD trials proved dapagliflozin reduced HF hospitalizations and CKD progression; FDA approved new indications 2020-2021
milestones.still_missing_zh: 机制研究仍在进行；费用-效益和更广泛人群可及性仍需改善
milestones.still_missing_en: Mechanism research ongoing; cost-effectiveness and broader population access still need improvement

milestones.headline_zh: 度普利尤单抗（Dupixent）获批，成为首个靶向IL-4/IL-13双重信号通路的生物制剂
milestones.headline_en: Dupilumab (Dupixent) approved — first biologic targeting the IL-4/IL-13 pathway across multiple diseases
milestones.before_gap_zh: 中重度特应性皮炎缺乏有效的靶向生物治疗，患者依赖皮质类固醇，副作用大
milestones.before_gap_en: Moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis lacked effective biologic options; patients relied on corticosteroids with significant side effects
milestones.achievement_zh: Dupixent先后获批特应性皮炎、哮喘、鼻窦炎伴鼻息肉、嗜酸性食管炎等多个适应证，成为全球销售额最高的免疫学药物之一
milestones.achievement_en: Dupixent sequentially approved in AD, asthma, CRSwNP, EoE and more; became one of the highest-revenue immunology drugs globally
milestones.still_missing_zh: 价格仍是主要障碍，生物类似药竞争预期在2030年代加剧
milestones.still_missing_en: High price remains barrier; biosimilar competition expected to intensify in 2030s

milestones.headline_zh: 第一三共与默沙东签署多达USD 220亿的ADC平台合作，创历史最大制药交易之一
milestones.headline_en: Daiichi Sankyo signs up to USD 22B ADC collaboration with Merck, one of the largest pharma deals ever
milestones.before_gap_zh: ADC平台在全球缺乏足够大规模商业化资源，无法覆盖肿瘤所有适应症
milestones.before_gap_en: ADC platform lacked the commercial scale and reach to develop across all oncology indications globally
milestones.achievement_zh: 与默沙东签署涵盖3款DXd ADC（Dato-DXd、HER3-DXd、I-DXd）合作协议，总价值达USD 220亿，Enhertu已实现全球多适应症突破
milestones.achievement_en: USD 22B Merck collaboration covering three DXd ADCs; Enhertu achieved multi-indication global breakthrough with over JPY 552B FY2024 sales
milestones.still_missing_zh: ADC耐药机制尚未完全解决；间质性肺炎（ILD）安全性问题仍需长期监测
milestones.still_missing_en: ADC resistance mechanisms not fully resolved; ILD safety signal requires ongoing long-term monitoring

milestones.headline_zh: Leqembi（仑卡奈单抗）获FDA完全批准——首个获传统批准的阿尔茨海默症疾病修饰疗法
milestones.headline_en: Leqembi receives FDA traditional approval — first disease-modifying Alzheimer's therapy with traditional approval
milestones.before_gap_zh: 此前无任何疾病修饰性阿尔茨海默症疗法获得FDA传统批准；十余年无新药批准
milestones.before_gap_en: No disease-modifying Alzheimer's therapy had traditional FDA approval; over a decade without new AD approvals
milestones.achievement_zh: Leqembi于2023年7月7日获FDA传统批准；CLARITY-AD试验显示认知衰退减缓27%；2024年11月获EU批准
milestones.achievement_en: Traditional FDA approval July 7, 2023; CLARITY-AD trial showed 27% slowing of cognitive decline; EU approval November 2024
milestones.still_missing_zh: 仅适用于早期患者；ARIA（淀粉样蛋白相关影像异常）安全风险仍存；高昂费用限制可及性；中晚期阿尔茨海默症仍无效治疗
milestones.still_missing_en: Limited to early-stage patients; ARIA safety risk remains; high cost limits access; no effective therapy for moderate-to-late AD

milestones.headline_zh: Hemlibra（艾美赛珠单抗）：全球首个获批双特异性抗体药物，革命性改写血友病A治疗
milestones.headline_en: Hemlibra (emicizumab): World's first approved bispecific antibody drug; revolutionized hemophilia A treatment
milestones.before_gap_zh: 血友病A患者需每周多次静脉注射凝血因子VIII替代品；抑制物患者疗效受限，生活质量极差
milestones.before_gap_en: Hemophilia A patients required frequent IV factor VIII infusions; patients with inhibitors had limited options and poor quality of life
milestones.achievement_zh: Hemlibra通过双臂同时结合FIXa和FX模拟FVIII辅因子功能，实现皮下每周/每两周/每月给药；获批血友病A伴或不伴抑制物患者
milestones.achievement_en: Hemlibra mimics FVIII cofactor via bispecific FIXa/FX bridging; enables SC weekly/biweekly/monthly dosing; approved for hemophilia A with and without inhibitors
milestones.still_missing_zh: 血友病B覆盖仍有限（NXT007尚在临床开发中）；长期出血率预防不能达100%
milestones.still_missing_en: Hemophilia B coverage still limited (NXT007 in development); breakthrough bleeding not fully eliminated

milestones.headline_zh: 速福达（巴洛沙韦）：全新机制流感药物，40年来第一个全新作用靶点抗流感药
milestones.headline_en: Xofluza (baloxavir): First flu drug with a novel mechanism in 40 years, targeting cap-dependent endonuclease
milestones.before_gap_zh: 流感抗病毒药物长达40年仅有神经氨酸酶抑制剂（如奥司他韦）和M2离子通道阻断剂，均存在耐药风险
milestones.before_gap_en: Influenza antivirals had been limited to neuraminidase inhibitors (like oseltamivir) and M2 blockers for 40 years, both with resistance concerns
milestones.achievement_zh: 巴洛沙韦靶向CEN（帽依赖性核酸内切酶），单剂口服治疗流感，单次给药方案显著改善依从性
milestones.achievement_en: Baloxavir targets CEN (cap-dependent endonuclease); single-dose oral treatment for influenza; significant compliance advantage
milestones.still_missing_zh: PA-I38T耐药突变在部分患者中出现；非流感季销售额受季节性波动影响大
milestones.still_missing_en: PA-I38T resistance mutation emerges in some patients; sales highly seasonal and weather-dependent

milestones.headline_zh: 小野药品Opdivo（纳武利尤单抗）：全球首个获批PD-1抑制剂，开创肿瘤免疫治疗新纪元
milestones.headline_en: Ono's Opdivo (nivolumab): World's first approved PD-1 inhibitor, inaugurating the cancer immunotherapy era
milestones.before_gap_zh: 晚期黑色素瘤及多种实体瘤缺乏有效免疫治疗；PD-1通路的免疫检查点抑制作用尚未被临床验证
milestones.before_gap_en: Advanced melanoma and most solid tumors lacked effective immunotherapy; the PD-1 checkpoint pathway had not been clinically validated
milestones.achievement_zh: Opdivo于2014年9月在日本首先获批治疗黑色素瘤，成为全球首批PD-1抑制剂；源于本庶佑教授的PD-1发现（2018年Nobel奖）
milestones.achievement_en: Opdivo became the world's first approved PD-1 inhibitor, approved in Japan September 2014; originated from Prof. Tasuku Honjo's discovery (Nobel Prize 2018)
milestones.still_missing_zh: 部分肿瘤类型应答率仍低；免疫相关不良反应管理挑战；初始耐药和获得性耐药机制仍需突破
milestones.still_missing_en: Response rates still low in some tumor types; immune-related adverse events remain a management challenge; primary and acquired resistance mechanisms unresolved

milestones.headline_zh: FDA批准全球首个间充质基质细胞疗法Ryoncil，用于儿童急性移植物抗宿主病
milestones.headline_en: FDA approves world's first mesenchymal stromal cell therapy Ryoncil for pediatric acute GvHD
milestones.before_gap_zh: 儿童类固醇难治性急性GvHD死亡率极高，此前缺乏标准化的细胞治疗批准方案。
milestones.before_gap_en: Pediatric SR-aGvHD carried very high mortality; no standardized approved cellular therapy existed.
milestones.achievement_zh: 2024年12月18日FDA批准remestemcel-L（Ryoncil），成为全球首个获FDA批准的MSC疗法，III期临床试验ORR达70.4%。
milestones.achievement_en: FDA approved remestemcel-L (Ryoncil) on 18 December 2024 — first FDA-approved MSC therapy globally; Phase 3 ORR of 70.4%.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 尚未获得成人SR-aGvHD及其他炎症适应症批准；商业规模放大及定价仍是挑战。
milestones.still_missing_en: Adult SR-aGvHD and other inflammatory indications not yet approved; commercial scale-up and pricing remain challenges.

milestones.headline_zh: Telix制药Illuccix 2024年全年收入突破7.83亿澳元，成为澳大利亚生物技术的里程碑式商业成就
milestones.headline_en: Telix Illuccix delivers A$783M FY2024 revenue — landmark commercial success for Australian biotech
milestones.before_gap_zh: Ga-68 PSMA PET成像在美国可及性有限，缺乏商业化规模的供应链。
milestones.before_gap_en: Ga-68 PSMA PET imaging had limited US accessibility and lacked commercial-scale supply chain.
milestones.achievement_zh: Illuccix成为美国市场主导性前列腺癌PSMA PET显像剂，FY2024收入同比增长56%，达7.83亿澳元（约5.17亿美元）。
milestones.achievement_en: Illuccix became the leading PSMA PET imaging agent in the US; FY2024 revenue A$783M (+56% YoY), demonstrating commercial-scale radiopharmaceutical logistics.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 治疗性放射性配体（如Gozellix、Zircaix）尚处于临床/审批阶段，治疗性商业化有待实现。
milestones.still_missing_en: Therapeutic radioligand products (Gozellix, Zircaix) still in clinical/regulatory stage; therapeutic commercial revenue not yet achieved.

sources.title: Telix FY2024 Full Year Results IR Release

milestones.headline_zh: 赛尔群Remsima单品年销售额首次突破1万亿韩元，欧洲市场份额达62%
milestones.headline_en: Celltrion Remsima surpasses KRW 1 trillion annual sales for the first time; 62% European market share
milestones.before_gap_zh: 生物类似药市场准入受到原研药品牌效应制约，市场份额增长缓慢。
milestones.before_gap_en: Biosimilar market penetration constrained by brand loyalty to originators; slow market share growth.
milestones.achievement_zh: 2024年Remsima IV年销售额首次超过1万亿韩元，同时在欧洲市场占62%份额，证明高价原研生物药可被有效竞争替代。
milestones.achievement_en: Remsima IV exceeded KRW 1 trillion in 2024 for the first time, holding 62% European market share — proving large-scale originator displacement by biosimilars.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 美国市场份额仍显著低于欧洲；价格竞争压缩利润空间；尚需扩展至更多生物类似药管线。
milestones.still_missing_en: US market share significantly trails Europe; pricing competition compresses margins; pipeline diversification ongoing.

sources.title: Celltrion's 2024 revenue hits record high – Korea BioMed

milestones.headline_zh: Keytruda成为全球最畅销药品，首个年销售额突破220亿美元的抗肿瘤药
milestones.headline_en: Keytruda becomes world's best-selling drug, first oncology drug to surpass $22B in annual sales
milestones.before_gap_zh: 此前全球最畅销药物长期为修美乐（Humira）等免疫类药物，肿瘤领域无法与之竞争规模
milestones.before_gap_en: Global top-selling drugs were long dominated by immunology products like Humira; oncology could not compete at that scale
milestones.achievement_zh: Keytruda（帕博利珠单抗）2023年销售额达220亿美元，超越修美乐成为全球第一，2024年进一步增长至295亿美元
milestones.achievement_en: Keytruda (pembrolizumab) reached $22B in 2023 to dethrone Humira as the global top-selling drug, growing further to $29.5B in 2024
milestones.still_missing_zh: Keytruda专利将于2028年前后到期，届时生物类似药冲击将考验默克的收入替代能力
milestones.still_missing_en: Keytruda LOE around 2028 will pressure Merck to replace $30B+ revenue through pipeline and MK-7264/coformulations

sources.title: Merck Q4 and Full-Year 2024 Financial Results

milestones.headline_zh: 礼来替西帕肽（Mounjaro+Zepbound）2024年合计营收164亿美元，引领GLP-1/GIP双靶点减重革命
milestones.headline_en: Lilly tirzepatide (Mounjaro+Zepbound) hits $16.4B combined in 2024, leading the dual GLP-1/GIP weight-loss revolution
milestones.before_gap_zh: 此前肥胖症无突破性药物疗法，GLP-1单靶点药物疗效有限；2型糖尿病市场格局陈旧
milestones.before_gap_en: No breakthrough drug therapy for obesity; single GLP-1 agents had limited efficacy; T2D market was mature without step-change innovation
milestones.achievement_zh: 替西帕肽同时激活GLP-1和GIP两个肠促胰素受体，在III期试验中减重幅度超过20%；2024年Mounjaro（糖尿病）115亿美元+Zepbound（减重）49亿美元
milestones.achievement_en: Tirzepatide activates both GLP-1 and GIP receptors, achieving >20% weight loss in Phase 3; 2024: Mounjaro $11.5B + Zepbound $4.9B combined
milestones.still_missing_zh: 产能仍是瓶颈；口服剂型尚在研发中；心血管/肾脏适应症有待更多数据
milestones.still_missing_en: Manufacturing capacity remains a bottleneck; oral formulation still in development; additional CV/renal indications need more data

milestones.headline_zh: FDA批准Casgevy，全球首个CRISPR基因疗法正式上市，用于镰状细胞病
milestones.headline_en: FDA approves Casgevy, the world's first CRISPR gene therapy, for sickle cell disease
milestones.before_gap_zh: 镰状细胞病为遗传性血液病，无法根治；既有治疗仅能缓解症状，骨髓移植风险高且供体难觅
milestones.before_gap_en: Sickle cell disease is a debilitating genetic blood disorder with no cure; existing treatments only manage symptoms; bone marrow transplant is high-risk and requires matched donors
milestones.achievement_zh: Vertex/CRISPR Therapeutics联合研发的Casgevy通过CRISPR-Cas9编辑BCL11A基因，上调胎儿血红蛋白，2023年12月获FDA批准，III期试验中97%患者在12个月内无血管闭塞危象
milestones.achievement_en: Casgevy (co-developed with CRISPR Therapeutics) uses CRISPR-Cas9 to edit BCL11A and upregulate fetal hemoglobin; FDA approved Dec 2023; 97% of patients had no vaso-occlusive crises at 12 months in Phase 3
milestones.still_missing_zh: 价格极高（约220万美元/疗程），可及性受限；制造复杂度和基因编辑长期安全性仍需观察
milestones.still_missing_en: Extremely high price (~$2.2M per treatment) limits access; manufacturing complexity and long-term safety of genome editing require ongoing monitoring

sources.title: Vertex Q4 and Full-Year 2024 Financial Results

milestones.headline_zh: Dupixent 2024年全球销售额达141.5亿美元，成为史上最成功的生物制剂之一
milestones.headline_en: Dupixent reaches $14.15B in global sales in 2024, becoming one of the most successful biologics ever launched
milestones.before_gap_zh: 特应性皮炎、哮喘等Th2炎症疾病缺乏精准靶向生物制剂；以往仅有激素和广谱免疫抑制药物
milestones.before_gap_en: Type 2/Th2 inflammatory diseases like atopic dermatitis and asthma lacked precision-targeted biologics; only steroids and broad immunosuppressants were available
milestones.achievement_zh: Dupixent（度普利尤单抗）靶向IL-4Rα同时阻断IL-4/IL-13通路，已获批超过7个适应症；2024年销售额同比增长22%达141.5亿美元，是Regeneron与赛诺菲合作研发的成果
milestones.achievement_en: Dupixent (dupilumab) targets IL-4Rα to block both IL-4/IL-13 pathways; approved in 7+ indications; 2024 global net sales grew 22% to $14.15B; co-developed with Sanofi
milestones.still_missing_zh: 适应症仍有扩展空间；价格较高制约患者可及性；生物类似药竞争预计2030年代中期开始
milestones.still_missing_en: Further indication expansion ongoing; high price limits access in many markets; biosimilar competition expected in the mid-2030s

sources.title: Regeneron Q4 and Full-Year 2024 Financial Results

milestones.headline_zh: 全球首个获批的 mRNA COVID-19 疫苗
milestones.headline_en: World's first authorized mRNA COVID-19 vaccine
milestones.before_gap_zh: 尚无商业化 mRNA 疫苗平台
milestones.before_gap_en: No commercialized mRNA vaccine platform existed
milestones.achievement_zh: BNT162b2/Comirnaty 在约 10 个月内完成开发并获多国紧急/附条件批准，开启 mRNA 疫苗时代
milestones.achievement_en: BNT162b2/Comirnaty developed and authorized in ~10 months across multiple jurisdictions, launching the mRNA vaccine era
milestones.still_missing_zh: mRNA 疫苗在低收入国家冷链与产能分配仍不均衡
milestones.still_missing_en: Uneven cold-chain infrastructure and manufacturing access for mRNA vaccines in low-income countries

milestones.headline_zh: Moderna 首款获 FDA 正式批准的 mRNA 疫苗
milestones.headline_en: Moderna's first FDA-approved mRNA vaccine (BLA)
milestones.before_gap_zh: Spikevax 此前仅持有紧急使用授权
milestones.before_gap_en: Spikevax was previously available only under Emergency Use Authorization
milestones.achievement_zh: mRNA-1273 获 FDA 生物制品许可申请（BLA）正式批准，确立 mRNA 平台监管路径
milestones.achievement_en: mRNA-1273 received full FDA Biologics License Application approval, establishing regulatory pathway for mRNA platform
milestones.still_missing_zh: mRNA 平台在非 COVID 适应症的大规模商业化仍在早期
milestones.still_missing_en: Large-scale commercialization of mRNA platform beyond COVID remains early-stage

milestones.headline_zh: 中国首个获批 COVID-19 疫苗
milestones.headline_en: China's first approved COVID-19 vaccine
milestones.before_gap_zh: 中国尚无自主 COVID-19 疫苗获批
milestones.before_gap_en: No domestically developed COVID-19 vaccine approved in China
milestones.achievement_zh: 国药中生北京所 BBIBP-CorV 获 NMPA 附条件批准，报告保护效力 79.34%
milestones.achievement_en: Sinopharm CNBG Beijing Institute BBIBP-CorV received NMPA conditional approval with reported 79.34% efficacy
milestones.still_missing_zh: 灭活疫苗对变异株的中和抗体衰减快于 mRNA 平台
milestones.still_missing_en: Inactivated vaccines show faster neutralizing antibody waning vs mRNA platforms against variants

milestones.headline_zh: 首款获 FDA 授权的蛋白亚单位 COVID-19 疫苗
milestones.headline_en: First FDA-authorized protein subunit COVID-19 vaccine
milestones.before_gap_zh: 美国尚无非 mRNA/非腺病毒载体的 COVID 疫苗获批
milestones.before_gap_en: No non-mRNA, non-adenoviral COVID vaccine authorized in the U.S.
milestones.achievement_zh: NVX-CoV2373（Nuvaxovid）成为美国首个获批的重组蛋白纳米颗粒 COVID 疫苗
milestones.achievement_en: NVX-CoV2373 (Nuvaxovid) became the first authorized recombinant protein nanoparticle COVID vaccine in the U.S.
milestones.still_missing_zh: 商业化规模落后于 mRNA 疫苗，需依赖 CMO 与合作伙伴
milestones.still_missing_en: Commercial scale lagged mRNA vaccines; reliant on CMOs and partners

milestones.headline_zh: 全球最大疫苗剂量生产商
milestones.headline_en: World's largest vaccine manufacturer by dose volume
milestones.before_gap_zh: 全球疫苗供应高度集中于少数发达国家厂商
milestones.before_gap_en: Global vaccine supply was concentrated among a few manufacturers in developed countries
milestones.achievement_zh: 血清研究所年产逾 15 亿剂疫苗，供应 170 余国，估计全球约 65% 儿童至少接种一剂 SII 疫苗
milestones.achievement_en: SII produces and sells over 1.5 billion vaccine doses annually to 170+ countries; estimated ~65% of children worldwide receive at least one SII-manufactured vaccine
milestones.still_missing_zh: 新兴疫苗（如 HPV、mRNA）产能与西方国家仍有差距
milestones.still_missing_en: Capacity for newer vaccines (e.g. HPV, mRNA) still trails Western manufacturers

milestones.headline_zh: 中国首个单剂腺病毒载体 COVID-19 疫苗获批
milestones.headline_en: China's first single-dose adenoviral vector COVID-19 vaccine approved
milestones.before_gap_zh: 中国尚无腺病毒载体 COVID 疫苗获批
milestones.before_gap_en: No adenoviral vector COVID vaccine approved in China
milestones.achievement_zh: 康希诺 Ad5-nCoV（克威莎）获 NMPA 附条件批准，采用单剂接种方案
milestones.achievement_en: CanSino Ad5-nCoV (Convidecia) received NMPA conditional approval with single-dose regimen
milestones.still_missing_zh: 腺病毒载体疫苗对预存免疫人群免疫原性受限
milestones.still_missing_en: Adenoviral vector vaccines face reduced immunogenicity in pre-immune populations
